title.narrative: Protection and Restoration of Exploited Children in Karamoja (PREC-Karamoja)

description.narrative: The impact of PREC is the prevention and reduction of exploitative child labour through strengthened civil society action in three districts of the Karamoja region by 2026. This will be achieved through the four interrelated objectives: SO1 Strengthened environment around, and improved resilience of, child and family to prevent and protect against exploitative CL. SO2 Influenced socio-cultural norms in targeted communities to prevent and reduce exploitative CL. SO3 Enhanced resilience and livelihoods of children and families who are vulnerable/victims of exploitative CL. SO4 Influenced government policies and systems to address exploitative CL.These objectives will be achieved through three pathways: 1) prevention of CL (targeting children with focus on girls), 2) restoration of victims through families and communities and, 3) capacity strengthening of CP actors.
